_comment: AI-Assisted: Claude Code (model: claude-opus-5) - Authored per 004 data-model.md §2.3-§2.4 and contracts/authored-summary-gates.md §5.1 (004 task T014), for curation/glossary.json. One file, a bare array, keyed by keyword_key: 60-100 records diff well in one file and a glossary has no natural faction partition. THE DIGEST LIMITATION, RECORDED RATHER THAN ENGINEERED AROUND: no keyword glossary source exists. Where the current edition publishes a description for a keyword the digest is over that text and the entry behaves exactly like an ability summary; where it does not, the digest is over the normalised keyword stem, which is stable by construction, so such an entry NEVER auto-flags for re-review. The compensating controls are GLS-ORPHANED and a manual reviewer sweep of the digest-less subset -- enumerated in summary-coverage.md -- before WGC_GATE_GLOSSARY is switched on for the first time. The alternatives (digesting the usage set, or digesting nothing) would either churn constantly or hide the gap.
title: curation/glossary.json

keyword_key.description: The normalised key of contracts/bundle-schema-delta.md §4. Casing, spacing, punctuation, and numeric-parameter variants of one keyword all collapse to this, so they cannot produce duplicate entries (FR-023).

mechanic_digest.description: A KEYED, TRUNCATED digest over the hard-normalised mechanic text where one exists, and over the normalised keyword stem where it does not (§5.1).
